title: Black Forest Labs releases FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6B open image model
friendlyTitle: A smaller open model for making and editing pictures
summary: Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6-billion-parameter open-weights model for text-to-image generation, editing and up to 10 reference images. The company says an INT8 build runs on NVIDIA GeForce RTX cards with 8GB of VRAM, and that the distilled INT8 model makes a 1-megapixel image in about 4 seconds on an RTX 5090 and under 9 seconds on an RTX 4070. Weights are on Hugging Face under the FLUX Kommunity License.
friendlySummary: Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3 Image Klein, an open model with 5.6 billion parameters. It can make pictures from text, edit pictures, and use up to 10 reference images. The company says a compressed version runs on an NVIDIA graphics card with 8GB of memory.
whyItMatters: People who edit photos on their own machine have a smaller open model that the maker says fits an 8GB card, with ComfyUI and Diffusers support. The quality rankings are the company's internal tests. Free commercial use covers individuals and companies with under $5 million in annual revenue; larger organisations need a licence or the API.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can try local image editing without a huge model. The speed and quality numbers are the company's own tests. Free commercial use is for people and smaller companies; larger firms need a paid licence.
